# Material 3

Material 3 applies the Material Design 3 visual style to Obsidian, deriving its color schemes from Obsidian's own brand colors. Editor panes, sidebars and menus are styled consistently, and the recorded description states that dynamic Android color theming is not supported.

![Material 3 screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/harmfulbreeze/obsidian-material-3-theme/HEAD/screenshot.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Material 3"
    author: "harmfulbreeze"
    repo:   "harmfulbreeze/obsidian-material-3-theme"

    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/harmfulbreeze/obsidian-material-3-theme/HEAD/screenshot.png"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Apply a Material Design 3 visual style to Obsidian with color schemes derived from Obsidian's brand colors. Bring consistent, clean styling to editor panes, sidebars, and menus; note dynamic Android color theming is not supported."
}
```
